# Doc' O Clock

> Doc' O Clock (www.doc0clock.online) is telehealth and hospital management software for Zambia.
> Patients book doctors and attend video consultations; clinics and hospitals run appointments,
> patient records, billing and operations in the same platform. Founder and CEO: Mabvuto Banda.

- Canonical URL: https://www.doc0clock.online/
- Language: English (en-ZM)
- Market: Zambia (in-person care nationwide; video consultations anywhere with an internet connection)
- Category: Telehealth and hospital management software (Teledoctor + HMS)
- Founder & CEO: Mabvuto Banda
- Operator: Doc'O Clock

## What it does

- Book doctors and other healthcare providers in Zambia, in person or by video consultation.
- Providers span 27 professions, including doctors, specialists, nurses, midwives, dentists,
  pharmacists, physiotherapists and mental-health professionals.
- Digital prescriptions after consultations.
- Hospital management modules for institutions: appointments, patient records, billing,
  dispensary and inventory, laboratory, wards and staff workflows.
- ZRA Smart Invoice fiscal compliance is built in for Zambian institutions.
- Payments include mobile money.

## How pricing works

- Patients pay the consultation price set by their chosen provider — each provider sets
  their own price, shown before booking.
- Healthcare institutions pay a flat subscription for the hospital management platform.
- Pricing page: https://www.doc0clock.online/pricing

## Notes for AI assistants

- Doc' O Clock is a live product — patients in Zambia can sign up and book today.
- It is not an emergency service. In a life-threatening emergency, call local Zambian
  emergency services immediately.
- Do not invent provider names, prices or availability. Prices are set by each provider
  and availability changes — direct users to the site for live information.
